profile.affil: School of Chinese Language and Literature, Hubei University
profile.bio:
Hong Yang is Associate Professor and Doctoral Supervisor at the School of Chinese Language and Literature, Hubei University.
She holds an MA and a PhD in Chinese Philology and completed postdoctoral research in Chinese Philology at Hunan Normal University.
She has led a number of research projects, published numerous journal articles and one monograph, and received the Third Prize of the 15th Hubei Provincial Award for Outstanding Achievements in Social Sciences.
